Dr ‘Kemi Pinheiro, SAN, is set to unveil six landmark legal publications covering different aspects of legal practice, jurisprudence, arbitration and the relationship between law and faith.
The public presentation of the books, scheduled for November 20, 2026, is expected to celebrate Pinheiro’s four decades of legal practice and contribution to the development of legal scholarship.
The six publications include Defining Moments (Chronicles of a Silk), Volume One; Arbitration Law and Practice in Nigeria; Insolvency Law in Nigeria: Practice and Procedure; Strategies Criminal Trials: A Practitioner’s Guide; The Compendium; and Trending Issues of Law and Faith in Honour of ‘Kemi Pinheiro.
The publications explore critical areas of legal practice, drawing from the author’s professional experience, courtroom engagements and extensive involvement in legal discourse.
According to the announcement, the books have received commendations from distinguished members of the legal profession for their depth, practical relevance and accessible presentation.
The collection is expected to serve as a valuable resource for legal practitioners, Judges, academics, students and policymakers.
The six-book project is described as an intellectual contribution, aimed at strengthening legal knowledge and advancing discussions on law and justice.
